name: Sunset Reset by Baek Jaekwang
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Sunset Reset recipe brings a warm, soft, and soothing feel to your images, inspired by the idea of home as a place for comfort in a cold, digital world. It’s perfect for capturing heartwarming moments in everyday life — like family dinners or quality time with friends or pets — conveying a sense of warmth and tranquility to viewers. This recipe also works beautifully with golden light and interior indirect lighting. The name “Sunset Reset” reflects the idea of seeing the sunset as a chance to reset and embrace new beginnings.
